subject.statement: René Benko was sentenced to two years in prison by the Innsbruck Regional Court in October 2025.

summary: As of late 2024 and early 2025, René Benko was under investigation for alleged fraud related to the Signa Holding insolvency, but no credible reports indicate he had been sentenced to prison by the Innsbruck Regional Court in October 2025. No record of such a conviction appears in reliable sources up to mid‑2026.
